name: dftracer_optimize_memory
description: Memory component of the dftracer optimizer: the 10-dimension memory checklist (buffer pooling, in-place ops, cache blocking, allocator, pinned memory, huge pages, middleware buffers, NUMA binding, VM tuning, roofline check) and built-in strategies for mem_bw (opt_memory_checklist); dftracer_optimize_memory_check validates the findings table.
